exact_statement: For every uniform-cube Boolean sign and finite deterministic fresh-singleton stopping tree, on its actual coherent root lift let S be the root Fourier-square sample, Q the final queried set, W=S\Q, D=S intersect Q, and A any fixed superset of all possibly queried coordinates. With a=I_A(f) and R=I(f)-E I(f_leaf), the injected information is e=I(W;Pi|S)=H(D|S), E|D|=R, a-R=E I_A(f_leaf), and e<=a h2(R/a). The bound is the cross-entropy of ONE normalized conditional reference rho_theta(d|S)=theta^|d|(1-theta)^(|S intersect A|-|d|), theta=R/a, minus its conditional KL. Root-Markov compatibility of the actual W is equivalent to e=0. Every leaf independent of A implies e=0 despite variable query sets; E I_A(f_leaf)<=kappa R implies e<=(1+kappa)h2(1/(1+kappa))R. With output information o and Gamma_W=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|W), one has o/2+[Gamma_W]_+/2<=R/ln(2)+e/2. The coefficient one in the active entropy capacity is asymptotically sharp on A048's actual indexed-parity point-defect family with k=2r+2. Arbitrary overlapping or identical terminal data cores are permitted when all controller dependence is resolved. Terminal Fourier entropy and influence remain retained; no universal history-bank supply or FEI conclusion is proved.

exact_statement: For every actual Boolean sign under an independent interior product law and finite deterministic fresh-singleton physical stopping tree, let S be the coherent root Fourier set, Pi its transcript, W=S minus Q(Pi), and A contain every potentially queried coordinate. Set a_i=P(i in S) for i in A, r_i=P(i in S intersect Q), a=sum a_i, r=sum r_i, R_phys=I_phys(f)-E I_phys(f_leaf). Then a_i=4p_i(1-p_i)Inf_i^phys(f), r_i=sum_{v querying i}w_v4p_i(1-p_i)Inf_i^phys(f_v), a_i-r_i equals expected terminal spectral i-influence, and r<=R_phys. With e=I(W;Pi|S), one normalized coordinate-product deletion reference with theta_i=r_i/a_i gives the exact identity e+E KL(P(D|S)||rho(.|S))=C_coord=sum_i a_i h2(r_i/a_i), including zero/full-deletion endpoints. Thus e<=C_coord<=a h2(r/a)<=a<=I_phys(f). Actual descendant conversion together with output release costs at most 2R_phys/ln2+C_coord/2 (uniform R_phys/ln2+C_coord/2). Terminal independence of A forces C_coord=e=0 even with variable query sets and shared terminal cores. For three-bit biased parity queried first on coordinate 0 and then coordinate 1 or 2 according to outcome, e=(b1+b2-b1*b2)h2(p0), C_coord=(b1+b2)h2(p0), and exact KL=b1*b2*h2(p0), where bi=4pi(1-pi). On p0=epsilon,p1=epsilon^2,p2=3/4, common-capacity/C_coord tends to 19/3. No conditional transcript bank funding or FEI theorem is established.
